company.name: August Home
company.shortDescription: August Home develops smarter home access products and services that allow physical environments to seamlessly respond to user behavior.
company.description:
August develops smarter home access products and services that allow physical environments to seamlessly respond to user behavior. Its flagship product, the August Smart Lock, is a new home access system that allows you to use smartphones in place of traditional keys.

August is founded by famed designer Yves Behar and consumer technology veteran Jason Johnson and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: August Home is researching intelligent door lock systems, as described in 'Video recording triggered by a smart lock device.' The abstract details a system where a door status device, coupled to a lock's drive shaft, assists in locking and unlocking at a dwelling. This system enables video recording to be triggered by the smart lock device, integrating access control with responsive monitoring. These efforts focus on enhancing home access and security through smart, behavior-responsive technologies.
